signals.detail: Gold up 9.3% over the month while the 10Y real yield rises to 2.42%. The textbook inverse relationship is not operating - consistent with central bank buying running near twice its historical pace. Read gold as a reserve-demand signal here, not a real-rate signal.
signals.title: Gold rising WITH real yields
